title: Resilience of Entropy Model in Distributed Neural Networks
caption: Fig. 2: A general framework for entropy coding in neural data compression. It consists of an encoder-decoder structure to extract a compact latent representation z and a prior model to estimate the distribution PZ(z). Left: During training, the prior model is jointly optimized with the encoder-decoder backbone. Right: During inference, the learned prior PZ(z) is used as side information for arithmetic encoding/decoding.
